integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with a supplementary finite numerical checker; no independent scientific review or empirical validation.
scientific_limitations: Two standard-uniform marginals and unknown strictly positive smooth copula; two symmetric linear-congestion resources only.
Endpoints of attainable intervals are excluded but sharply approximable.
Optimal and equilibrium identified sets are separate; not a complete jointly attainable pair classification.
Historical priority is bounded to inspected material, not established by negative searches.
source_ids: Makarov (1982), Theory of Probability and its Applications 26(4):803–806
title: Sharp dependence-robust equilibrium and optimal shares in a two-destination congestion game
